uncovered_shapes.sentence: A few morphologists inside Rijkswaterstaat had already warned, in internal reports from the early 1980s, that the smaller tidal prism would leave the channels oversized and that sediment would have to come from somewhere to restore equilibrium.

One can trace the arithmetic: a 30-percent drop in peak velocity reduces transport capacity by roughly 75 percent according to the power-law relationship between velocity and sediment movement, so the channels could no longer rebuild what waves removed.
